name: Reconciled
summary: Two of the same man across one chronal thread, and the younger one has read the register.
epilogue: It was never going to be a fight anybody else could win. You brought the only person in three centuries with standing to contest the position: the man who signed it, before he signed it.

He does not destroy the chassis. He files. A founder's objection, entered by the original party to the instrument, at a moment when the instrument was still capable of being objected to, and the chair cannot rule it out of order because the chair is the same signature.

The Board dissolves itself rather than answer the question of which Strand is the shareholder of record. The Steward is left holding a charter with two names on it and no way to prefer either, and does the only reasonable thing, which is to publish the problem and wait.
coda: He is twenty-nine and he has just spent three hundred years of his own future to stop being that. Nobody thanks him. He did not ask anybody to.
